signal_description: Houston plans to call up Ethan Pecko to start Wednesday against the Angels in what would be his MLB debut.
headline: Pecko moves from call-up watch to confirmed promotion path
why_now: A credible pre-catalyst watch has advanced: Houston now plans to promote Pecko for a specific MLB start. The hobby question is whether his thin 1st Bowman Chrome autograph market remains underpriced before the debut itself.
thesis: Ethan Pecko has advanced from PRE_CATALYST to an ENTRY-stage call-up catalyst. Monitor his 2025 Bowman Chrome 1st prospect autograph immediately, but authorize no capital action until authoritative Product Research comps establish whether speculation already repriced the card.
falsification: Houston reverses the plan before Pecko is added to the roster.
Authoritative sold comps show the prospect-auto market already repriced the call-up beyond an attractive entry.
The debut does not lead to a sustained rotation opportunity.

cards.label: 2025 Bowman Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-EPE Ethan Pecko
cards.rationale: Verified 1st Bowman Chrome prospect autograph; repricing must be checked before the scheduled MLB debut.

signal_description: The Giants are calling up left-hander Matt 'Tugboat' Wilkinson for what is expected to be his MLB debut.
headline: Tugboat Wilkinson call-up creates a fresh, low-consensus MLB catalyst
why_now: Wilkinson has a memorable nickname, strikeout-heavy prospect profile, WBC visibility and a same-day MLB promotion. His hobby footprint is substantially colder than top hitting prospects, which makes this an asymmetric but liquidity-sensitive catalyst rather than a consensus chase.
thesis: Matt Wilkinson is a fresh ENTRY-stage call-up candidate. His 2025 Bowman Chrome BCP-145 and CPA-MW are the clearest expressions, but pitcher hobby risk and likely thin liquidity require authoritative sold-comp verification before any capital action.
falsification: The reported call-up does not result in an MLB roster addition or debut opportunity.
Authoritative sold comps show insufficient liquidity to establish a trustworthy entry level.
The call-up produces no measurable hobby demand despite the nickname and debut narrative.

cards.label: 2025 Bowman Chrome Prospects BCP-145 Matt Wilkinson
cards.rationale: Verified Bowman Chrome prospect identity with broader liquidity than the autograph; use as the first repricing check.

cards.label: 2025 Bowman Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-MW Matt Wilkinson
cards.rationale: Verified Bowman Chrome prospect autograph and higher-conviction expression if actual sold depth exists.
